beats.say: What was the Fire Ball? A thrill ride built by a Dutch company, KMG, in 1999.

moments.what: three crew members walk the ride's gate

params.place: the midway of the Ohio State Fair on a summer day

moments.what: the ride swings through a full cycle

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Every ride ran the same program, all day long. So what made the last ride different? It starts with how the Fire Ball swings.

params.place: the ride alone against the evening sky

moments.what: the chapter card types on: the swing

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The Fire Ball is a giant pendulum. A long boom hangs from the top of a tower, and at its foot sits a wheel of arms.

moments.what: each swing goes higher
the camera rides up with a gondola of riders

things: the crowd on the midway below

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The boom swings higher and higher, until riders look down on the fair from far above it.

moments.what: the gondola rushes through the bottom, the lights streak
a heavy arrow presses down on the seat
the gondola slows at the top over the midway
the arrow shrinks to almost nothing

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Down at the bottom of each swing, riders are pressed hard into their seats. Up at the top, they feel almost weightless.

params.place: beside the wheel at the top of the swing

moments.what: the boom slows at the top
the wheel spins, gondolas sweeping past
a gondola passes close to the camera
light trails streak behind the seats

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Near the top of each swing, the wheel spins too, so every gondola turns through the air.

params.place: below the ride, looking up as the wheel passes overhead

moments.what: the wheel rushes down toward the camera
the arms flash grey to amber as it passes
the swing slows into slow motion at the bottom
a time-paused tag appears

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Why does that matter for the steel? Because of what happens at the bottom of every swing.

params.place: an engineer's force sheet on the desk

moments.what: the pendulum draws on the sheet
a weight arrow points down from the gondola
a second arrow adds to it
the arm's tension arrow grows long
the swing arc draws through the gondola

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Down at the bottom, each arm holds its gondola's weight, plus the extra pull it takes to swing that gondola round the curve.

params.place: a load gauge pinned beside the force sheet

moments.what: the load gauge needle climbs
the needle swings up
it falls back
a load trace draws, peak after peak
the trace runs off the edge of the sheet

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So the load on each arm climbs and falls, again and again, on every swing of every ride.

params.place: the force sheet, a section of the arm drawn on it

moments.what: tally marks fill the margin, fair after fair
the tally fills faster
a section of the arm's wall draws on
the wall's thickness is marked with a bracket

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Over a season, that is a huge number of loads. Steel takes it well, as long as the steel keeps its full thickness.

params.place: close on one sweep arm as the ride swings at dusk

moments.what: the ride swings past, the camera holds on one arm
the arm passes again
the arm flashes amber at the bottom
the arm turns see-through: its wall is thin inside
the paint closes over it again

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Up to here: a ride on the road, the same swing all day, and arms loaded on every pass. But what if one arm's steel was getting thinner, where nobody could see?

params.place: one sweep arm of the ride, cut open under work lights

moments.what: the chapter card types on: the hollow arm
the gondola mount at its end lights
the near wall lifts away
the camera looks down the inside of the tube

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Each arm that carried a gondola was a hollow steel beam, like a long square tube.

params.place: one sweep arm of the ride, cut open under work lights

moments.what: the arm lifts easily on its crane hook
the load arrows press on it, it holds
the camera slides into the open end
the end plate closes over the opening

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Hollow beams are light and strong. But a tube has an inside, and once the ride is built, that inside is out of sight.

params.place: a cross-section of the beam on the drafting sheet

moments.what: the beam's cross-section draws on
a drop falls toward a seam
rain streaks down the sheet
drops find the seam and run in
water pools at the low end inside

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: What gets in there? Water. Rain can seep into a beam and pool inside it.

params.place: the beam's cross-section at night on the sheet

moments.what: a haze of damp air fills the tube
a thermometer arrow drops, the sheet turns blue
a moon slides over the corner
beads of water form on the inner walls

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Even without rain, damp air inside can cool overnight and leave water on the inner walls.

params.place: inside the hollow arm, lit by a single work lamp

moments.what: water glistens along the floor of the tube
orange rust blooms across the inner wall
the camera turns: both ends are shut
the water sits still in its pool

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Wet steel rusts. And inside a closed tube, the water has nowhere to go, and no sun or wind to dry it out.

params.place: the Fire Ball standing in the rain at a night fair

moments.what: rain falls on the ride, crowds hurry past
the sky flicks from night to day and back
the fair around it changes
one arm glows amber through the rain
the camera pushes toward that arm

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And who would notice? Season after season, fair after fair, the rust can eat into the wall from the inside.

params.place: the wall section on the drafting sheet, new beside old

moments.what: two wall sections draw: new and after years
rust eats the inner face of the old one
the outer faces stay the same
the paint line stays bright on both

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The wall gets thinner. From outside, it can still look sound, and its paint can still look fine.

params.place: the wall sections on the drafting sheet, load arrows on both

moments.what: the two wall sections sit side by side
the same load arrow presses on both
the arrow pulses with each swing
the thin section's stress colour climbs to red

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Thinner steel still carries the same load. So with every swing, the same pull lands on less and less metal.

params.place: the ride at morning, an inspector's flashlight on the arm

moments.what: a flashlight beam sweeps along the painted arm
the beam pauses on a bolt
a clipboard rises into frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So how would anyone find it? That's what the inspections were for.

params.place: the ride at morning, its crew with clipboards

moments.what: the chapter card types on: the inspections
the crew walk round the base
a daily check sheet fills with ticks
the sheet goes on a stack of others

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: A ride like this is checked again and again. Its crew kept daily inspection and maintenance reports.

params.place: close on the ride's control panel, covered in stickers

moments.what: the camera drifts across the booth's side
the first inspection sticker slaps on
more state inspection stickers press on, one, then another
the row of stickers fills

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Each state on its route had its own inspectors. Stickers from several of them were on the ride.

params.place: the ride in morning light, two state inspectors at the base

moments.what: the morning light comes up on the ride
the inspectors' badges catch the light
they climb the platform
the empty fair waits behind them

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: In Ohio, the Department of Agriculture inspects rides. Its inspectors checked the Fire Ball before the fair began.

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the inspection report slides onto the desk
the date line highlights
a PASSED stamp lands
an in-operation tag clips on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Their standard inspection report is dated the first day of the fair. The ride passed, and was in full operation.

params.place: close along the ride as an inspector works

moments.what: a flashlight beam lands on the arm
a bolt glints in the beam
the beam runs along a weld
a shoulder bar lifts and locks
the panel lights blink

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: What does an inspection look at? What can be seen and tested: the bolts, the welds, the bars, and the controls.

params.place: the painted arm with the inspector's light on it, seen through the wall

moments.what: the arm turns see-through
rust shows inside the paint
the flashlight beam stops dead at the paint
the arm turns solid again

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But the inside wall of an arm, once the ride is put together, can't be seen at all.

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the commission's letter slides onto the desk
the camera pushes to the line
the line highlights
the quote types on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Federal safety staff later put it plainly. With no means to see inside the beam, a visual inspection after the ride is in place would not detect corrosion thinning of internal walls.

params.place: the midway of the Ohio State Fair on a summer day

moments.what: the gates open, crowds flow in
the sticker on the panel catches the sun
one arm glints
the sky starts to turn orange

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So the Fire Ball opened with a passed inspection, and an arm nobody could check. It took one evening.

params.place: the fair's main gate in morning light

moments.what: the chapter card types on: the last day
the gate sign lights
the rides start up behind the gate
the first visitors walk through

params.caption: day

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It was the first day of the 2017 Ohio State Fair. The rides opened in the morning.

params.place: the queue at the Fire Ball at midday

moments.what: families walk the midway past food stands
a line snakes up to the ride's gate
the ride swings behind them
the gondolas empty and fill again

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Families came through the gates. Lines formed at the thrill rides, and the Fire Ball ran ride after ride.

params.place: the Fire Ball swinging over the afternoon crowd

moments.what: the ride swings over the afternoon crowd
the camera follows one arm through a swing
it flashes amber at the bottom, unseen
from the crowd's eye level, the paint shines
a family walks past, eating

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: All day, the arms took load after load. And from the ground, nothing looked any different.

params.place: the early-evening midway in summer daylight

moments.what: the sun hangs low and gold behind the Ferris wheel
the rides turn over the busy midway
the strings of lights glow, row by row
the crowds keep walking past the Fire Ball

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: By early evening, the fair was still in full swing in the summer daylight. The lights along the midway glowed, and the crowds stayed.

params.place: one sweep arm of the ride, cut open under work lights

moments.what: the cut-open arm flexes under the work lights
the stress colour pulses amber
the rust inside darkens
the cut edge shows a thin wall, red at the joint

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Every swing loaded the arms again. Inside one of them, the rust was out of sight, and the wall was thin.

params.place: the loading platform in the early-evening light

moments.what: low sun falls across the platform
riders' shadows pass the gate
the shoulder bars swing down
the seat lights go green, one by one

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Early that evening, riders climbed into the gondolas. Bars came down. Green lights came on.

params.place: the Fire Ball on the midway in the early-evening sun, the fair lit around it

moments.what: the boom swings out
the crowd at the rail watches
each pass goes higher
the wheel starts to spin

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The ride began to swing, higher with every pass.

params.place: close on the joint at the end of the arm, mid-swing in the early-evening sky

moments.what: silence: the arm's joint glows from amber to red as the ride swings
the camera rides along with the arm mid-swing
the joint flashes red
the joint tears apart, sparks and flakes of rust burst out, the frame dips to white

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Then, in the middle of a swing, the arm gave way.

params.place: the fair in the evening light, seen from across the midway

moments.what: from far away, the wheel swings on, one gondola missing
dust rises beside the ride
the bare arm end is red
the crowd at the rail turns away
the ride slows to a stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: A gondola broke away from the end of its arm and came down on the ground beside the ride.

params.place: the ride in the evening light, an evidence truck by the tape

moments.what: an ambulance and a fire truck pull up, lights pulsing
rescuers with lamps hurry to the base
tape stretches round the ride
a flatbed carries the gondola away under a tarp

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Emergency crews arrived after calls for help. Investigators secured the ride, and the gondola was taken away as evidence.

params.place: the midway in daylight, rides still, the Fire Ball taped off

moments.what: daylight on a silent midway
a chain pulls across a ride gate
a stop notice pins to the Fire Ball's fence
the camera rises over the still rides

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The next day, every ride at the fair stayed shut. And the ride's maker ordered rides like it shut down around the world.

params.place: close on the broken arm end, taped off in daylight

moments.what: the camera drifts along the bare arm
a bead of water drips from its open end
flakes of rust on the deck below
the sticker on the panel behind
the camera pushes into the open end

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Add it up: a hollow arm, water inside it, rust out of sight, and an inspection that passed. What would investigators find inside the broken arm?

params.place: the taped-off ride the morning after, an investigator arriving

moments.what: the chapter card types on: the findings
a car pulls up by the tape
the investigator ducks under the tape with a camera
the camera flash fires at the base

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Next came the Consumer Product Safety Commission. It sent an investigator, who reached the ride the next day.

params.place: inside the broken arm, lit by the investigator's light

moments.what: a flashlight beam enters the open end
the beam moves down the tube
rust lights up on every wall
the camera travels the whole length: rust all the way

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: What was inside? The investigator looked at the arm the gondola broke from. Rust covered its entire inside.

params.place: the broken end of the arm under a work lamp

moments.what: the camera circles the jagged end
one side of the break lights
then all sides light up
the rust on the break face glows orange

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Every side of the break looked covered in rust, too.

params.place: a secure evidence building, the gondola on a pallet

moments.what: fluorescent lights flicker on over the gondola
a roller door rolls down
an evidence tag hangs on the gondola
a lamp lights the gondola's broken mount

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So did the gondola that broke away, kept in a secure evidence building: rust inside it, and round every side of the break.

params.place: the taped-off ride in daylight, engineers photographing the arm

moments.what: two engineers walk to the tape
one kneels at the broken arm, a lamp on it
a camera flash fires at the arm end
an as-reported tag: corrosion thinned the wall
the camera pushes on the thin bare edge

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The maker's engineers came to see the ride too. The company said its tests showed corrosion had dangerously thinned the beam's wall.

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the alert sheet slides onto the desk
a stack of inspector badges fans out
a route map with pins slides behind
the camera pushes in

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: A safety alert about the ride went out to inspectors across the industry. Here is what it warned.

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the alert's line highlights
the word corrosion underlines red
the quote types on
a wall-thickness bracket draws beside it
the joint words highlight
normal operation underlines

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Excessive corrosion inside the gondola support beam can lead to a hazardous wall thickness reduction of the beam and its adjacent joint, causing the beam to fail under normal operation.

params.place: one sweep arm of the ride, cut open under work lights

moments.what: the cut-open arm turns under the lamps
the beam's inner wall lights amber
the joint at its end lights red
the gondola mount below it lights

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Notice where it points: the beam, and the joint next to it, where the gondola hangs.

params.place: the Fire Ball on the midway in the early-evening sun, the fair lit around it

moments.what: the ride swings in an ordinary evening loop
a storm cloud tag crosses out
a misuse tag crosses out
the same arm glows red on an ordinary pass

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Normal operation. No storm, no misuse: a beam that thin could fail on an ordinary ride.

params.place: inside the arm, an endoscope's light coming down it

moments.what: grit blasts the outside clean
a scope cable feeds into the open end
its lit tip glides down the tube
the scope's screen shows the rust

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The alert called for beams to be sandblasted clean, and inspected inside with an endoscope or a video scope.

params.place: the scope's screen held beside the arm

moments.what: the scope screen glows orange with rust
the tip light blinks inside the tube
the camera pulls back out of the tube
a letter slides past the frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So the rust could be found, with a camera inside the steel. What did the regulators ask for next?

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the chapter card types on: what changed
the letter slides onto the desk
the address line highlights
the standards committee's name underlines

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: In September of 2017, the commission's safety staff wrote to the committee that writes the industry's ride standards at ASTM.

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the request list appears on the letter
request one ticks: no pooling water
request two ticks: see inside the beam
request three ticks: judge the corrosion

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: They asked for three things: designs that stop water pooling inside critical parts, a way to see inside structural beams, and rules for judging corrosion and what to do about it.

params.place: a different fairground far away, a ride like the Fire Ball shut down

moments.what: a ride like the Fire Ball stands still at another fair
the sky over it is a different country's evening
a stop notice pins to its fence
a crew member feeds a scope into an arm

things: a ride like the Fire Ball

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Owners of the same model around the world had to stop and check inside their beams before running again.

params.place: the state fair grounds in a later season, rides running again

moments.what: a new season: the fair's lights on again
a law document pins over the midway
a pen signature draws across it
fairgoers walk past the empty spot where the Fire Ball stood

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Ohio changed its own law too. Its governor signed a new law, named after the young rider who was killed.

params.place: the investigator's desk

moments.what: the law's page slides in
fatigue and corrosion highlight
a camera snaps, a photo pins to the page
an engineer's seal stamps on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Owners of bigger rides must now have a yearly fatigue and corrosion review, every major repair must be photographed, and a professional engineer sits on the state's ride advisory board.

params.place: one sweep arm of the ride, cut open under work lights

moments.what: the arm sits under the work lights, painted and whole
an as-reported tag appears
a flashlight beam stops at the paint
the arm turns see-through: rust inside
a pulse of light passes through the wall

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Is that enough? One ride operator said the new law still missed the point: rust inside a beam shows up only to tests that look through the steel.

params.place: the wall section on the drafting sheet, a probe on it

moments.what: a probe presses onto the painted wall
a sound pulse travels into the steel
it bounces back off the rusted inner face
the thickness bracket draws: thin, red

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: One such test sends a pulse of sound into the wall. The echo off the inner face tells you how thick the steel really is.

params.place: the painted arm under the work lights, then seen through

moments.what: the camera drifts along the painted arm
the paint gleams under the lamp
a passed sticker on the arm catches the light
the arm turns see-through, rust everywhere inside
a pulse runs through the wall and lights it red

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And that is the lesson of the Fire Ball. The paint looked fine. The sticker said passed. The danger was inside, where only the right test could see it.

params.place: the investigation board on the desk

moments.what: link one stamps
link two stamps
link three stamps
link four stamps, red

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: A hollow arm. Water with nowhere to go. Rust working out of sight. And checks that could only see the outside.

moments.what: the ride swings high in the early-evening sun

the date caption types on again, as at the start
